nodes.label: D-181: D-180's R53-R56 Corrected; Current T5/T6 Anchor
nodes.description: Chief Editor ruling answering B-068 S22's independent re-review of D-180. Three prior planning rounds with Lane B (B-068 S22.5-S22.7) corrected the proposed write set before any file was touched; this decision applies the corrected set. B068-R53: Modular_PRD.md gains AC-22, a governed Product AC for consuming-gate evidence, scoped to the explicit gate feature-group list FR-01/FR-02/FR-03/FR-04a/FR-05a (not a range), citing FN-GATES-01-05.md S11.1 for elaboration rather than duplicating it. B068-R54: D-180 had created a Product AC-01a for the EW-start trigger that collided with the existing Fn_Spec AC-01a (the G39 analytical-tag criterion) -- renumbered the Product criterion to AC-01b; the Fn_Spec AC-01a is untouched. B068-R55: Modular_PRD.md gains G-02a, the target-held independence-bypass metric -- only T6 may be satisfied, T1-T5 and Delivery are not_applicable, a logged override remains override_not_four_eyes. B068-R56: raci-involvement-matrix.md S3.1 had given both T5a and T5b the Drafted to Reviewed transition while also saying the join makes no state change -- mutually inconsistent and a race condition if built. Corrected so every T5/T5a/T5b act seals judgment only, article state stays Drafted, and the T5_review_bundle_sealed join alone performs the single transition once every route-required act is sealed; FN-GATES-01-05.md S11.1 and V1-BUILD-SPEC.md's target S2 DoD restate the same rule. D-180's B068-R50-R52 corrections are preserved unedited (forward notice added above its body, not a rewrite); D-171's S2 hold is unaffected and not reopened. No B-070 created (B-068 S22 is the sole handoff item per Lane B); V1-ARTIFACT-INVENTORY.md untouched since no file was created or retired.
nodes.rationale: A correcting decision that itself introduces new defects needs the same discipline applied to it that found the original defects -- three rounds of Lane B review before any file changed, and a forward notice rather than a rewrite of the decision being corrected, so provenance survives two supersession hops instead of collapsing into one edited record.
